+whenever the direction is nonzero there.  This is the generic direct
+diagonal sample: the sampled index is recovered from the projected direction
+alone. -/
+theorem directDiagonalIndexOf_prefixProjection (D : DirectLdParams)
+    (i : Fin D.m) (v : Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D) (hi : v i ≠ 0) :
+    directDiagonalIndexOf D (directPrefixProjection i v) = i := by
+  apply directDiagonalIndexOf_eq
+  · intro j hj
+    simp [directPrefixProjection, hj]
+  · simpa [directPrefixProjection] using hi
+
+/-- Prefix projection at the leading index is the identity. -/
+theorem directPrefixProjection_directDiagonalIndexOf (D : DirectLdParams)
+    (v : Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D) :
+    directPrefixProjection (directDiagonalIndexOf D v) v = v := by
+  funext j
+  unfold directPrefixProjection
+  split_ifs with hj
+  · exact (directDiagonalIndexOf_prefix_zero D v j hj).symm
+  · rfl
+
+/-! ## Decoding mature points and lines -/
+
+/-- Decode a mature LDT point into the fixed direct scalar field, reversing
+the coordinate order. -/
+abbrev ldtPointToDirect (D : DirectLdParams) :
+    Point D.toLDTParameters → Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D :=
+  (directPointEquiv D).symm
+
+/-- The direct canonical axis question represented by a mature axis line.
+The mature coordinate index is reversed together with the point
+coordinates. -/
+noncomputable def directAxisQuestionOf (D : DirectLdParams)
+    (line : AxisParallelLine D.toLDTParameters) : DirectLdQuestion D :=
+  let u := ldtPointToDirect D line.base
+  let i : Fin D.m := Fin.rev line.direction
+  let v : Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D := coordinateDirection i
+  (.aline, ⟨lineRepMap v u, i, 0⟩)
+
+/-- The direct canonical diagonal question represented by a mature diagonal
+line.  The decoded direction is kept and the direct index is its leading
+index, so the question is the canonical direct question of the direct sample
+formed by the decoded base, the leading index, and the decoded direction
+(`directDiagonalQuestionOf_eq_directLdMap`). -/
+noncomputable def directDiagonalQuestionOf (D : DirectLdParams)
+    (line : DiagonalLine D.toLDTParameters) : DirectLdQuestion D :=
+  let u := ldtPointToDirect D line.base
+  let v := ldtPointToDirect D line.direction
+  (.dline, ⟨lineRepMap v u, directDiagonalIndexOf D v, v⟩)
+
+/-- The direct point question represented by a mature LDT point. -/
+noncomputable def directPointQuestionOf (D : DirectLdParams)
+    (u : Point D.toLDTParameters) : DirectLdQuestion D :=
+  directLdPointQuestionOf D (ldtPointToDirect D u)
+
+/-- Every transported diagonal question is the canonical direct question of
+the direct sample carrying the leading index, hence lies in the support of
+the direct diagonal sampler. -/
+theorem directDiagonalQuestionOf_eq_directLdMap (D : DirectLdParams)
+    (line : DiagonalLine D.toLDTParameters) :
+    directDiagonalQuestionOf D line =
+      (.dline, directLdMap D .dline
+        ⟨ldtPointToDirect D line.base,
+          directDiagonalIndexOf D (ldtPointToDirect D line.direction),
+          ldtPointToDirect D line.direction⟩) := by
+  unfold directDiagonalQuestionOf directLdMap
+  simp only [directPrefixProjection_directDiagonalIndexOf]
+
+/-- The mature diagonal line represented by a direct sample: the encoded
+point and the encoded direction. -/
+def matureDiagonalLineOf (D : DirectLdParams) (sample : DirectLdSpace D) :
+    DiagonalLine D.toLDTParameters :=
+  { base := directPointEquiv D sample.point
+    direction := directPointEquiv D sample.direction }
+
+/-- Round trip on generic direct samples: when the sampled direction is
+nonzero at the sampled index, the mature line of the canonical direct
+diagonal question transports back to that question, index included. -/
+theorem directDiagonalQuestionOf_matureDiagonalLineOf (D : DirectLdParams)
+    (sample : DirectLdSpace D)
+    (hgeneric : sample.direction sample.index ≠ 0) :
+    directDiagonalQuestionOf D
+        (matureDiagonalLineOf D (directLdMap D .dline sample)) =
+      (.dline, directLdMap D .dline sample) := by
+  cases sample with
+  | mk point index direction =>
+      unfold directDiagonalQuestionOf matureDiagonalLineOf directLdMap
+      simp only [ldtPointToDirect, Equiv.symm_apply_apply, lineRepMap_apply_self,
+        directDiagonalIndexOf_prefixProjection D index direction hgeneric]
+
+/-- A mature `j`-restricted diagonal direction decodes to a direct direction
+vanishing before index `Fin.rev j`: the suffix restriction of the mature
+test is the prefix restriction of the direct game. -/
+theorem ldtPointToDirect_extendRestrictedDirection_prefix_zero
+    (D : DirectLdParams) (j : Fin D.m)
+    (free : Fin (j.val + 1) → Fq D.toLDTParameters) :
+    letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
+    ∀ c : Fin D.m, c.val < (Fin.rev j).val →
+      ldtPointToDirect D (extendRestrictedDirection j free) c = 0 := by
+  letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
+  intro c hc
+  have hj := j.isLt
+  have hgt : ¬ (Fin.rev c).val ≤ j.val := by
+    rw [Fin.val_rev] at hc ⊢
+    omega
+  simp only [ldtPointToDirect, directPointEquiv_symm_apply,
+    extendRestrictedDirection, dif_neg hgt]
+  exact (FieldModel.equiv (q := D.q)).symm_apply_apply 0
+
+/-- The leading index of a decoded `j`-restricted direction is `Fin.rev j`
+exactly on the generic event that its pivot coordinate `j` is nonzero. -/
+theorem directDiagonalIndexOf_extendRestrictedDirection
+    (D : DirectLdParams) (j : Fin D.m)
+    (free : Fin (j.val + 1) → Fq D.toLDTParameters) :
+    letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
+    free ⟨j.val, Nat.lt_succ_self _⟩ ≠ zeroCoord →
+      directDiagonalIndexOf D
+          (ldtPointToDirect D (extendRestrictedDirection j free)) =
+        Fin.rev j := by
+  letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
+  intro hpivot
+  apply directDiagonalIndexOf_eq
+  · exact ldtPointToDirect_extendRestrictedDirection_prefix_zero D j free
+  · simp only [ldtPointToDirect, directPointEquiv_symm_apply, Fin.rev_rev,
+      extendRestrictedDirection, dif_pos (le_refl j.val)]
+    intro h
+    apply hpivot
+    have hcoded := congrArg (directScalarEquiv D) h
+    rw [Equiv.apply_symm_apply] at hcoded
+    exact hcoded
+
+/-! ## Rebasing lines -/
+
+/-- Decoding an axis-line rebase is translation by the decoded scalar along
+the reversed direct coordinate direction. -/
+theorem ldtPointToDirect_axis_rebase (D : DirectLdParams)
+    (line : AxisParallelLine D.toLDTParameters)
+    (t : Fq D.toLDTParameters) :
+    letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
+    ldtPointToDirect D (line.rebaseAt t).base =
+      ldtPointToDirect D line.base +
+        (directScalarEquiv D).symm t •
+          coordinateDirection (Fin.rev line.direction) := by
+  letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
+  funext i
+  simp only [ldtPointToDirect, directPointEquiv_symm_apply,
+    AxisParallelLine.rebaseAt, AxisParallelLine.pointAt, Pi.add_apply,
+    Pi.smul_apply]
+  by_cases hi : i = Fin.rev line.direction
+  · subst hi
+    simp only [coordinateDirection, Fin.rev_rev, if_pos, smul_eq_mul]
+    rw [Pi.single_eq_same, mul_one]
+    exact (FieldModel.equiv (q := D.q)).symm_apply_apply _
+  · have hrev : Fin.rev i ≠ line.direction := by
+      intro h
+      apply hi
+      rw [← h, Fin.rev_rev]
+    simp [hi, hrev, coordinateDirection]
+
+/-- Decoding a diagonal-line rebase is translation by the decoded scalar
+along the decoded direct direction. -/
+theorem ldtPointToDirect_diagonal_rebase (D : DirectLdParams)
+    (line : DiagonalLine D.toLDTParameters)
+    (t : Fq D.toLDTParameters) :
+    letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
+    ldtPointToDirect D (line.rebaseAt t).base =
+      ldtPointToDirect D line.base +
+        (directScalarEquiv D).symm t • ldtPointToDirect D line.direction := by
+  letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
+  funext i
+  change decodeScalar
+      (addCoord (line.base (Fin.rev i))
+        (mulCoord t (line.direction (Fin.rev i)))) =
+    decodeScalar (line.base (Fin.rev i)) +
+      decodeScalar t * decodeScalar (line.direction (Fin.rev i))
+  simp [addCoord, mulCoord]
+
+/-- Canonical direct axis questions do not depend on the chosen base point of
+the mature line. -/
+theorem directAxisQuestionOf_rebase (D : DirectLdParams)
+    (line : AxisParallelLine D.toLDTParameters)
+    (t : Fq D.toLDTParameters) :
+    letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
+    directAxisQuestionOf D (line.rebaseAt t) = directAxisQuestionOf D line := by
+  letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
+  simp only [directAxisQuestionOf, AxisParallelLine.rebaseAt_direction]
+  rw [ldtPointToDirect_axis_rebase, lineRepMap_add_smul]
+
+/-- Canonical direct diagonal questions do not depend on the chosen base point
+of the mature line; the leading index depends only on the direction. -/
+theorem directDiagonalQuestionOf_rebase (D : DirectLdParams)
+    (line : DiagonalLine D.toLDTParameters)
+    (t : Fq D.toLDTParameters) :
+    letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
+    directDiagonalQuestionOf D (line.rebaseAt t) =
+      directDiagonalQuestionOf D line := by
+  letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
+  simp only [directDiagonalQuestionOf, DiagonalLine.rebaseAt]
+  have hrebase := ldtPointToDirect_diagonal_rebase D line t
+  change ldtPointToDirect D (line.pointAt t) =
+      ldtPointToDirect D line.base +
+        (directScalarEquiv D).symm t • ldtPointToDirect D line.direction at hrebase
+  rw [hrebase, lineRepMap_add_smul]
+
+/-- The fixed scalar coding transports field addition to mature coordinate
+addition. -/
+theorem directScalarEquiv_add (D : DirectLdParams)
+    (x y : DirectScalarQ D) :
+    letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
+    directScalarEquiv D (x + y) =
+      addCoord (directScalarEquiv D x) (directScalarEquiv D y) := by
+  letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
+  change FieldModel.equiv (x + y) =
+    FieldModel.equiv
+      (FieldModel.equiv.symm (FieldModel.equiv x) +
+        FieldModel.equiv.symm (FieldModel.equiv y))
+  rw [FieldModel.equiv.symm_apply_apply, FieldModel.equiv.symm_apply_apply]
+
+private theorem coordinateDirection_ne_zero
+    {K : Type*} [Field K] {m : ℕ} (i : Fin m) :
+    (coordinateDirection i : Fin m → K) ≠ 0 := by
+  intro h
+  have hi := congrFun h i
+  simp [coordinateDirection] at hi
+
+/-- Canonical rebase parameter for a mature axis-parallel line. -/
+noncomputable def directAxisRebaseParameter (D : DirectLdParams)
+    (line : AxisParallelLine D.toLDTParameters) : DirectScalarQ D :=
+  directLineRepParameter (coordinateDirection (Fin.rev line.direction))
+    (ldtPointToDirect D line.base)
+
+/-- Canonical rebase parameter for a mature diagonal line. -/
+noncomputable def directDiagonalRebaseParameter (D : DirectLdParams)
+    (line : DiagonalLine D.toLDTParameters) : DirectScalarQ D :=
+  directLineRepParameter (ldtPointToDirect D line.direction)
+    (ldtPointToDirect D line.base)
+
+/-- Axis-line canonical parameters add under mature rebasing. -/
+theorem directAxisRebaseParameter_rebase (D : DirectLdParams)
+    (line : AxisParallelLine D.toLDTParameters)
+    (t : Fq D.toLDTParameters) :
+    letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
+    directAxisRebaseParameter D (line.rebaseAt t) =
+      directAxisRebaseParameter D line + (directScalarEquiv D).symm t := by
+  letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
+  unfold directAxisRebaseParameter
+  rw [ldtPointToDirect_axis_rebase]
+  exact directLineRepParameter_add_smul
+    (coordinateDirection_ne_zero (Fin.rev line.direction)) _
+
+/-- Nonzero diagonal-line canonical parameters add under mature rebasing. -/
+theorem directDiagonalRebaseParameter_rebase (D : DirectLdParams)
+    (line : DiagonalLine D.toLDTParameters)
+    (t : Fq D.toLDTParameters)
+    (hdir : ldtPointToDirect D line.direction ≠ 0) :
+    letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
+    directDiagonalRebaseParameter D (line.rebaseAt t) =
+      directDiagonalRebaseParameter D line + (directScalarEquiv D).symm t := by
+  letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
+  unfold directDiagonalRebaseParameter
+  rw [ldtPointToDirect_diagonal_rebase]
+  exact directLineRepParameter_add_smul hdir _
+
+/-! ## Reading direct answers as mature answers -/
+
+/-- The constant diagonal-line answer with the given direct value. -/
+noncomputable def constantDiagonalAnswer (D : DirectLdParams)
+    (x : DirectScalarQ D) :
+    letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
+    DiagonalLinePolynomial D.toLDTParameters := by
+  letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
+  exact { poly := Polynomial.C x
+          degreeBounded := by simp }
+
+/-- Constant answers are fixed by every reparametrization. -/
+theorem constantDiagonalAnswer_reparamAt (D : DirectLdParams)
+    (x : DirectScalarQ D) (t : Fq D.toLDTParameters) :
+    letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
+    DiagonalLinePolynomial.reparamAt (constantDiagonalAnswer D x) t =
+      constantDiagonalAnswer D x := by
+  letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
+  apply DiagonalLinePolynomial.ext
+  simp [constantDiagonalAnswer, DiagonalLinePolynomial.reparamAt]
+
+/-- A constant answer evaluates to its value at every parameter. -/
+theorem constantDiagonalAnswer_apply (D : DirectLdParams)
+    (x : DirectScalarQ D) (t : Fq D.toLDTParameters) :
+    letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
+    constantDiagonalAnswer D x t = directScalarEquiv D x := by
+  letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
+  change encodeScalar ((Polynomial.C x).eval (decodeScalar t)) =
+    directScalarEquiv D x
+  rw [Polynomial.eval_C]
+  rfl
+
+/-- Read one simultaneous coordinate from a direct point answer. -/
+noncomputable def directPointAnswerReadout (D : DirectLdParams) (r : Fin D.k) :
+    letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
+    DirectLdAnswer D → Fq D.toLDTParameters := by
+  letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
+  intro answer
+  exact match answer with
+    | .pointVals a => directScalarEquiv D (a r)
+    | .alinePolys _ => directScalarEquiv D 0
+    | .dlinePolys _ => directScalarEquiv D 0
+
+/-- Read one simultaneous coordinate from a direct axis-line answer and
+rebase its polynomial from the canonical direct line to the mature line. -/
+noncomputable def directAxisAnswerReadout (D : DirectLdParams) (r : Fin D.k)
+    (line : AxisParallelLine D.toLDTParameters) :
+    letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
+    DirectLdAnswer D → AxisLinePolynomial D.toLDTParameters := by
+  letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
+  intro answer
+  exact match answer with
+    | .alinePolys a => AxisLinePolynomial.reparamAt
+        (directAxisAnswerEquiv D (a r))
+        (directScalarEquiv D (directAxisRebaseParameter D line))
+    | .pointVals _ => default
+    | .dlinePolys _ => default
+
+/-- Read one simultaneous coordinate from a direct diagonal-line answer.  For
+a nonzero direction the polynomial is rebased from the canonical direct line
+to the mature line.  A zero direction is the singleton line through its base,
+where the direct predicate accepts an answer exactly when its polynomial
+function is constant with the point's value (`rem:ld-win-zero-direction`);
+the answer is read as the constant polynomial carrying its value at the base
+point, which is fixed by every reparametrization.  Wrong-form answers are
+sent to the default polynomial. -/
+noncomputable def directDiagonalAnswerReadout (D : DirectLdParams) (r : Fin D.k)
+    (line : DiagonalLine D.toLDTParameters) :
+    letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
+    DirectLdAnswer D → DiagonalLinePolynomial D.toLDTParameters := by
+  letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
+  classical
+  intro answer
+  exact match answer with
+    | .dlinePolys a =>
+        if ldtPointToDirect D line.direction = 0 then
+          constantDiagonalAnswer D (evalCoefficient (a r) 0)
+        else
+          DiagonalLinePolynomial.reparamAt (directDiagonalAnswerEquiv D (a r))
+            (directScalarEquiv D (directDiagonalRebaseParameter D line))
+    | .pointVals _ => default
+    | .alinePolys _ => default
+
+/-- Axis answer readout is covariant under mature line rebasing. -/
+theorem directAxisAnswerReadout_rebase (D : DirectLdParams) (r : Fin D.k)
+    (line : AxisParallelLine D.toLDTParameters)
+    (t : Fq D.toLDTParameters) (answer : DirectLdAnswer D) :
+    letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
+    directAxisAnswerReadout D r (line.rebaseAt t) answer =
+      AxisLinePolynomial.reparamAt (directAxisAnswerReadout D r line answer) t := by
+  letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
+  cases answer with
+  | pointVals a => simp [directAxisAnswerReadout]
+  | dlinePolys a => simp [directAxisAnswerReadout]
+  | alinePolys a =>
+      simp only [directAxisAnswerReadout]
+      rw [directAxisRebaseParameter_rebase, directScalarEquiv_add]
+      rw [(directScalarEquiv D).apply_symm_apply]
+      exact (AxisLinePolynomial.reparamAt_reparamAt
+        (directAxisAnswerEquiv D (a r)) _ _).symm
+
+/-- Diagonal answer readout is covariant under mature line rebasing, including
+the constant zero-direction convention. -/
+theorem directDiagonalAnswerReadout_rebase (D : DirectLdParams) (r : Fin D.k)
+    (line : DiagonalLine D.toLDTParameters)
+    (t : Fq D.toLDTParameters) (answer : DirectLdAnswer D) :
+    letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
+    directDiagonalAnswerReadout D r (line.rebaseAt t) answer =
+      DiagonalLinePolynomial.reparamAt
+        (directDiagonalAnswerReadout D r line answer) t := by
+  letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
+  cases answer with
+  | pointVals a => simp [directDiagonalAnswerReadout]
+  | alinePolys a => simp [directDiagonalAnswerReadout]
+  | dlinePolys a =>
+      by_cases hdir : ldtPointToDirect D line.direction = 0
+      · have hrebase : ldtPointToDirect D (line.rebaseAt t).direction = 0 := by
+          simpa [DiagonalLine.rebaseAt] using hdir
+        simp [directDiagonalAnswerReadout, hdir, hrebase,
+          constantDiagonalAnswer_reparamAt]
+      · have hrebase : ldtPointToDirect D (line.rebaseAt t).direction ≠ 0 := by
+          simpa [DiagonalLine.rebaseAt] using hdir
+        simp only [directDiagonalAnswerReadout, hdir, hrebase, ↓reduceIte]
+        rw [directDiagonalRebaseParameter_rebase D line t hdir,
+          directScalarEquiv_add, (directScalarEquiv D).apply_symm_apply]
+        exact (DiagonalLinePolynomial.reparamAt_reparamAt
+          (directDiagonalAnswerEquiv D (a r)) _ _).symm
+
+end
+
+end MIPStarRE.QPBT

@@ -0,0 +1,141 @@
+import MIPStarRE.LDT.Basic.PMFAverages
+
+/-!
+# Marginals of finite distributions
+
+Shared push-forward lemmas for the project's finite `Distribution` type:
+extensionality through the associated probability mass function, composition
+of push-forwards, and the uniform first marginal of the uniform law on an
+explicit finite product.  They serve the marginal statements `lem:alnf` and
+`lem:dlnf` of the low-degree line-point laws and the question-law transport
+between the seed-indexed and directly indexed low-degree games.
+
+## References
+
+- `references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:243-272`
+- `docs/paper-gaps/qpbt_ld-dimension-divisibility.tex`
+-/
+
+open scoped BigOperators
+
+namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT
+
+open MIPStarRE.LDT
+
+/-- Two probabilistic finite distributions with the same stored support and
+the same associated probability mass function are equal. -/
+theorem distribution_eq_of_support_eq_of_toPMF_eq {alpha : Type*}
+    (mu nu : Distribution alpha) (hmu : mu.IsProbability)
+    (hnu : nu.IsProbability) (hsupport : mu.support = nu.support)
+    (hpmf : mu.toPMF hmu = nu.toPMF hnu) : mu = nu := by
+  have hweight : mu.weight = nu.weight := by
+    funext a
+    calc
+      mu.weight a = (mu.toPMF hmu a).toReal :=
+        (Distribution.toPMF_apply_toReal mu hmu a).symm
+      _ = (nu.toPMF hnu a).toReal := by rw [hpmf]
+      _ = nu.weight a := Distribution.toPMF_apply_toReal nu hnu a
+  cases mu with
+  | mk muSupport muWeight muNonnegative muOutsideSupport =>
+      cases nu with
+      | mk nuSupport nuWeight nuNonnegative nuOutsideSupport =>
+          cases hsupport
+          cases hweight
+          rfl
+
+/-- Composition of two push-forwards of a probabilistic finite distribution
+is the push-forward by the composite map. -/
+theorem distribution_map_map_of_isProbability
+    {alpha beta gamma : Type*} [DecidableEq beta] [DecidableEq gamma]
+    (mu : Distribution alpha) (hmu : mu.IsProbability)
+    (f : alpha → beta) (g : beta → gamma) :
+    (mu.map f).map g = mu.map (g ∘ f) := by
+  apply distribution_eq_of_support_eq_of_toPMF_eq
+    ((mu.map f).map g) (mu.map (g ∘ f))
+    ((hmu.map f).map g) (hmu.map (g ∘ f))
+  · simp [Distribution.map_support, Finset.image_image]
+  · calc
+      ((mu.map f).map g).toPMF ((hmu.map f).map g) =
+          ((mu.map f).toPMF (hmu.map f)).map g :=
+        Distribution.toPMF_map (mu.map f) (hmu.map f) g
+      _ = ((mu.toPMF hmu).map f).map g := by
+        rw [Distribution.toPMF_map mu hmu f]
+      _ = (mu.toPMF hmu).map (g ∘ f) :=
+        PMF.map_comp f (mu.toPMF hmu) g
+      _ = (mu.map (g ∘ f)).toPMF (hmu.map (g ∘ f)) :=
+        (Distribution.toPMF_map mu hmu (g ∘ f)).symm
+
+/-- Projection onto the first factor of an explicit finite product
+equivalence sends the uniform distribution to the uniform first marginal. -/
+theorem uniformDistribution_map_fst_of_equiv
+    {alpha beta gamma : Type*}
+    [Fintype alpha] [DecidableEq alpha] [Nonempty alpha]
+    [Fintype beta] [DecidableEq beta] [Nonempty beta]
+    [Finite gamma] [Nonempty gamma]
+    (e : alpha ≃ beta × gamma) (f : alpha → beta)
+    (hf : ∀ a, f a = (e a).1) :
+    (uniformDistribution alpha).map f = uniformDistribution beta := by
+  classical
+  letI : Fintype gamma := Fintype.ofFinite gamma
+  have hsurjective : Function.Surjective f := by
+    intro b
+    let c : gamma := Classical.choice (inferInstance : Nonempty gamma)
+    refine ⟨e.symm (b, c), ?_⟩
+    simpa using hf (e.symm (b, c))
+  apply distribution_eq_of_support_eq_of_toPMF_eq
+    ((uniformDistribution alpha).map f) (uniformDistribution beta)
+    ((uniformDistribution_isProbability alpha).map f)
+    (uniformDistribution_isProbability beta)
+  · rw [Distribution.map_support, uniformDistribution_support,
+      uniformDistribution_support,
+      Finset.image_univ_of_surjective hsurjective]
+  · calc
+      ((uniformDistribution alpha).map f).toPMF
+          ((uniformDistribution_isProbability alpha).map f) =
+          ((uniformDistribution alpha).toPMF
+            (uniformDistribution_isProbability alpha)).map f :=
+        Distribution.toPMF_map (uniformDistribution alpha)
+          (uniformDistribution_isProbability alpha) f
+      _ = (PMF.uniformOfFintype alpha).map f := by
+        rw [uniformDistribution_toPMF]
+      _ = (PMF.uniformOfFintype alpha).map
+          (Prod.fst ∘ e) := by
+            exact congrArg
+              (fun map : alpha → beta => (PMF.uniformOfFintype alpha).map map)
+              (funext fun a => by simpa [Function.comp_def] using hf a)
+      _ = ((PMF.uniformOfFintype alpha).map e).map Prod.fst :=
+        (PMF.map_comp e (PMF.uniformOfFintype alpha) Prod.fst).symm
+      _ = (PMF.uniformOfFintype (beta × gamma)).map Prod.fst := by
+        rw [PMF.uniformOfFintype_map_equiv e]
+      _ = PMF.uniformOfFintype beta := by
+        rw [PMF.uniformOfFintype_prod_eq_bind]
+        calc
+          ((PMF.uniformOfFintype beta).bind fun a =>
+              (PMF.uniformOfFintype gamma).map fun b => (a, b)).map Prod.fst =
+              (PMF.uniformOfFintype beta).bind (fun a =>
+                ((PMF.uniformOfFintype gamma).map fun b => (a, b)).map
+                  Prod.fst) :=
+            PMF.map_bind (PMF.uniformOfFintype beta)
+              (fun a => (PMF.uniformOfFintype gamma).map fun b => (a, b))
+              Prod.fst
+          _ = (PMF.uniformOfFintype beta).bind (fun a => PMF.pure a) := by
+            apply congrArg (fun q : beta → PMF beta =>
+              (PMF.uniformOfFintype beta).bind q)
+            funext a
+            calc
+              ((PMF.uniformOfFintype gamma).map fun b => (a, b)).map
+                  Prod.fst =
+                  (PMF.uniformOfFintype gamma).map
+                    (Prod.fst ∘ fun b => (a, b)) :=
+                PMF.map_comp _ (PMF.uniformOfFintype gamma) Prod.fst
+              _ = (PMF.uniformOfFintype gamma).map
+                  (Function.const gamma a) := by rfl
+              _ = PMF.pure a :=
+                PMF.map_const (PMF.uniformOfFintype gamma) a
+          _ = PMF.uniformOfFintype beta :=
+            PMF.bind_pure (PMF.uniformOfFintype beta)
+      _ = (uniformDistribution beta).toPMF
+          (uniformDistribution_isProbability beta) :=
+        (uniformDistribution_toPMF beta).symm
+
+end MIPStarRE.QPBT

    29	
    30	/-- A point differs from its canonical representative by a scalar multiple of
    31	the line direction. -/
    32	theorem mem_linePoints_direct_lineRepMap
    33	    {K : Type*} [Field K] {m : ℕ} (v u : Fin m → K) :
    34	    u ∈ linePoints (lineRepMap v u) v := by
    35	  let W : Submodule K (Fin m → K) := Submodule.span K ({v} : Set (Fin m → K))
    36	  let T : Submodule K (Fin m → K) :=
    37	    registerSubmodule K (canonicalComplement W)
    38	  have hdiff : u - lineRepMap v u ∈ W := by
    39	    simpa [lineRepMap, canonicalProjOfKernel, W, T, LinearMap.comp_apply] using
    40	      (Submodule.sub_projection_mem
    41	        (isCompl_registerSubmodule_canonicalComplement W).symm u)
    42	  rcases Submodule.mem_span_singleton.mp hdiff with ⟨t, ht⟩
    43	  refine ⟨t, ?_⟩
    44	  rw [ht]
    45	  abel
    46	
    47	/-- A chosen affine parameter expressing a point relative to its canonical
    48	line representative. -/
    49	noncomputable def directLineRepParameter
    50	    {K : Type*} [Field K] {m : ℕ} (v u : Fin m → K) : K :=
    51	  Classical.choose (mem_linePoints_direct_lineRepMap v u)
    52	
    53	/-- The chosen canonical rebase parameter reconstructs the original point. -/
    54	theorem directLineRepParameter_spec
    55	    {K : Type*} [Field K] {m : ℕ} (v u : Fin m → K) :
    56	    u = lineRepMap v u + directLineRepParameter v u • v :=
    57	  Classical.choose_spec (mem_linePoints_direct_lineRepMap v u)
    58	
    59	/-- Canonical line representatives are unchanged by translation along their
    60	direction. -/
    61	theorem lineRepMap_add_smul
    62	    {K : Type*} [Field K] {m : ℕ}
    63	    (v u : Fin m → K) (t : K) :
    64	    lineRepMap v (u + t • v) = lineRepMap v u := by
    65	  let W : Submodule K (Fin m → K) := Submodule.span K ({v} : Set (Fin m → K))
    66	  have hv : v ∈ W := Submodule.subset_span (Set.mem_singleton v)
    67	  have hzero : lineRepMap v v = 0 := by
    68	    simp [lineRepMap, canonicalProjOfKernel, W, LinearMap.comp_apply,
    69	      Submodule.projectionOnto_apply_of_mem_right
    70	        (isCompl_registerSubmodule_canonicalComplement W).symm hv]
    71	  simp [map_add, map_smul, hzero]
    72	
    73	/-- For a nonzero direction, the canonical rebase parameter is unique. -/
    74	theorem directLineRepParameter_eq_of_nonzero
    75	    {K : Type*} [Field K] {m : ℕ}
    76	    {v u : Fin m → K} (hv : v ≠ 0) {t : K}
    77	    (ht : u = lineRepMap v u + t • v) :
    78	    directLineRepParameter v u = t := by
    79	  have hfun : directLineRepParameter v u • v = t • v := by
    80	    apply add_left_cancel (a := lineRepMap v u)
    81	    exact (directLineRepParameter_spec v u).symm.trans ht
    82	  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ : ∃ i, v i ≠ 0 := by
    83	    by_contra h
    84	    apply hv
    85	    funext i
    86	    simpa using not_exists.mp h i
    87	  have hcoord := congrFun hfun i
    88	  simp only [Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul] at hcoord
    89	  exact mul_right_cancel₀ hi hcoord
    90	
    91	/-- Translating a point on a nonzero line adds the translation to its
    92	canonical rebase parameter. -/
    93	theorem directLineRepParameter_add_smul
    94	    {K : Type*} [Field K] {m : ℕ}
    95	    {v u : Fin m → K} (hv : v ≠ 0) (t : K) :
    96	    directLineRepParameter v (u + t • v) =
    97	      directLineRepParameter v u + t := by
    98	  apply directLineRepParameter_eq_of_nonzero hv
    99	  rw [lineRepMap_add_smul]
   100	  calc
   101	    u + t • v =
   102	        (lineRepMap v u + directLineRepParameter v u • v) + t • v := by
   103	      rw [← directLineRepParameter_spec v u]
   104	    _ = lineRepMap v u + (directLineRepParameter v u + t) • v := by
   105	      module

   107	/-- Decode a mature LDT point into the fixed direct scalar field. -/
   108	abbrev ldtPointToDirect (D : DirectLdParams) :
   109	    Point D.toLDTParameters → Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D :=
   110	  (directPointEquiv D).symm

   112	/-- The direct canonical axis question represented by a mature axis line. -/
   113	noncomputable def directAxisQuestionOf (D : DirectLdParams)
   114	    (line : AxisParallelLine D.toLDTParameters) : DirectLdQuestion D :=
   115	  let u := ldtPointToDirect D line.base
   116	  let v : Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D := coordinateDirection line.direction
   117	  (.aline, ⟨lineRepMap v u, line.direction, 0⟩)
   118	
   119	/-- The direct canonical diagonal question represented by a mature diagonal
   120	line.  The first direct index is valid for every direction. -/
   121	noncomputable def directDiagonalQuestionOf (D : DirectLdParams)
   122	    (line : DiagonalLine D.toLDTParameters) : DirectLdQuestion D :=
   123	  let u := ldtPointToDirect D line.base
   124	  let v := ldtPointToDirect D line.direction
   125	  (.dline, ⟨lineRepMap v u, D.firstIndex, v⟩)
   126	
   127	/-- The direct point question represented by a mature LDT point. -/
   128	noncomputable def directPointQuestionOf (D : DirectLdParams)
   129	    (u : Point D.toLDTParameters) : DirectLdQuestion D :=
   130	  directLdPointQuestionOf D (ldtPointToDirect D u)
   131	
   132	/-- Decoding an axis-line rebase is translation by the decoded scalar along
   133	the corresponding direct coordinate direction. -/
   134	theorem ldtPointToDirect_axis_rebase (D : DirectLdParams)
   135	    (line : AxisParallelLine D.toLDTParameters)
   136	    (t : Fq D.toLDTParameters) :
   137	    letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
   138	    ldtPointToDirect D (line.rebaseAt t).base =
   139	      ldtPointToDirect D line.base +
   140	        (directScalarEquiv D).symm t •
   141	          coordinateDirection line.direction := by
   142	  letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
   143	  funext i
   144	  simp only [ldtPointToDirect, directPointEquiv_symm_apply,
   145	    AxisParallelLine.rebaseAt, AxisParallelLine.pointAt, Pi.add_apply,
   146	    Pi.smul_apply]
   147	  by_cases hi : i = line.direction
   148	  · subst i
   149	    simp only [coordinateDirection, if_pos, smul_eq_mul]
   150	    rw [Pi.single_eq_same, mul_one]
   151	    exact (FieldModel.equiv (q := D.q)).symm_apply_apply _
   152	  · simp [hi, coordinateDirection]
   153	
   154	/-- Decoding a diagonal-line rebase is translation by the decoded scalar
   155	along the decoded direct direction. -/
   156	theorem ldtPointToDirect_diagonal_rebase (D : DirectLdParams)
   157	    (line : DiagonalLine D.toLDTParameters)
   158	    (t : Fq D.toLDTParameters) :
   159	    letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
   160	    ldtPointToDirect D (line.rebaseAt t).base =
   161	      ldtPointToDirect D line.base +
   162	        (directScalarEquiv D).symm t • ldtPointToDirect D line.direction := by
   163	  letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
   164	  funext i
   165	  change decodeScalar
   166	      (addCoord (line.base i) (mulCoord t (line.direction i))) =
   167	    decodeScalar (line.base i) + decodeScalar t * decodeScalar (line.direction i)
   168	  simp [addCoord, mulCoord]
   169	
   170	/-- Canonical direct axis questions do not depend on the chosen base point of
   171	the mature line. -/
   172	theorem directAxisQuestionOf_rebase (D : DirectLdParams)
   173	    (line : AxisParallelLine D.toLDTParameters)
   174	    (t : Fq D.toLDTParameters) :
   175	    letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
   176	    directAxisQuestionOf D (line.rebaseAt t) = directAxisQuestionOf D line := by
   177	  letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
   178	  simp only [directAxisQuestionOf, AxisParallelLine.rebaseAt_direction]
   179	  rw [ldtPointToDirect_axis_rebase, lineRepMap_add_smul]
   180	
   181	/-- Canonical direct diagonal questions do not depend on the chosen base point
   182	of the mature line. -/
   183	theorem directDiagonalQuestionOf_rebase (D : DirectLdParams)
   184	    (line : DiagonalLine D.toLDTParameters)
   185	    (t : Fq D.toLDTParameters) :
   186	    letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
   187	    directDiagonalQuestionOf D (line.rebaseAt t) =
   188	      directDiagonalQuestionOf D line := by
   189	  letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
   190	  simp only [directDiagonalQuestionOf, DiagonalLine.rebaseAt]
   191	  have hrebase := ldtPointToDirect_diagonal_rebase D line t
   192	  change ldtPointToDirect D (line.pointAt t) =
   193	      ldtPointToDirect D line.base +
   194	        (directScalarEquiv D).symm t • ldtPointToDirect D line.direction at hrebase
   195	  rw [hrebase, lineRepMap_add_smul]

   197	/-- The fixed scalar coding transports field addition to mature coordinate
   198	addition. -/
   199	theorem directScalarEquiv_add (D : DirectLdParams)
   200	    (x y : DirectScalarQ D) :
   201	    letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
   202	    directScalarEquiv D (x + y) =
   203	      addCoord (directScalarEquiv D x) (directScalarEquiv D y) := by
   204	  letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
   205	  change FieldModel.equiv (x + y) =
   206	    FieldModel.equiv
   207	      (FieldModel.equiv.symm (FieldModel.equiv x) +
   208	        FieldModel.equiv.symm (FieldModel.equiv y))
   209	  rw [FieldModel.equiv.symm_apply_apply, FieldModel.equiv.symm_apply_apply]

   211	private theorem coordinateDirection_ne_zero
   212	    {K : Type*} [Field K] {m : ℕ} (i : Fin m) :
   213	    (coordinateDirection i : Fin m → K) ≠ 0 := by
   214	  intro h
   215	  have hi := congrFun h i
   216	  simp [coordinateDirection] at hi

   218	/-- Canonical rebase parameter for a mature axis-parallel line. -/
   219	noncomputable def directAxisRebaseParameter (D : DirectLdParams)
   220	    (line : AxisParallelLine D.toLDTParameters) : DirectScalarQ D :=

   222	    (ldtPointToDirect D line.base)

   224	/-- Canonical rebase parameter for a mature diagonal line. -/
   225	noncomputable def directDiagonalRebaseParameter (D : DirectLdParams)
   226	    (line : DiagonalLine D.toLDTParameters) : DirectScalarQ D :=

   230	/-- Axis-line canonical parameters add under mature rebasing. -/
   231	theorem directAxisRebaseParameter_rebase (D : DirectLdParams)
   232	    (line : AxisParallelLine D.toLDTParameters)
   233	    (t : Fq D.toLDTParameters) :
   234	    letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
   235	    directAxisRebaseParameter D (line.rebaseAt t) =
   236	      directAxisRebaseParameter D line + (directScalarEquiv D).symm t := by
   237	  letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
   238	  unfold directAxisRebaseParameter
   239	  rw [ldtPointToDirect_axis_rebase]
   240	  exact directLineRepParameter_add_smul
   241	    (coordinateDirection_ne_zero line.direction) _
   242	
   243	/-- Nonzero diagonal-line canonical parameters add under mature rebasing. -/
   244	theorem directDiagonalRebaseParameter_rebase (D : DirectLdParams)
   245	    (line : DiagonalLine D.toLDTParameters)
   246	    (t : Fq D.toLDTParameters)
   247	    (hdir : ldtPointToDirect D line.direction ≠ 0) :
   248	    letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
   249	    directDiagonalRebaseParameter D (line.rebaseAt t) =
   250	      directDiagonalRebaseParameter D line + (directScalarEquiv D).symm t := by
   251	  letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
   252	  unfold directDiagonalRebaseParameter
   253	  rw [ldtPointToDirect_diagonal_rebase]

   256	/-- Read one simultaneous coordinate from a direct point answer. -/
   257	noncomputable def directPointAnswerReadout (D : DirectLdParams) (r : Fin D.k) :
   258	    letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
   259	    DirectLdAnswer D → Fq D.toLDTParameters := by
   260	  letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
   261	  intro answer
   262	  exact match answer with
   263	    | .pointVals a => directScalarEquiv D (a r)
   264	    | .alinePolys _ => directScalarEquiv D 0
   265	    | .dlinePolys _ => directScalarEquiv D 0
   266	
   267	/-- Read one simultaneous coordinate from a direct axis-line answer and
   268	rebase its polynomial from the canonical direct line to the mature line. -/
   269	noncomputable def directAxisAnswerReadout (D : DirectLdParams) (r : Fin D.k)
   270	    (line : AxisParallelLine D.toLDTParameters) :
   271	    letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
   272	    DirectLdAnswer D → AxisLinePolynomial D.toLDTParameters := by
   273	  letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
   274	  intro answer
   275	  exact match answer with
   276	    | .alinePolys a => AxisLinePolynomial.reparamAt
   277	        (directAxisAnswerEquiv D (a r))
   278	        (directScalarEquiv D (directAxisRebaseParameter D line))
   279	    | .pointVals _ => default
   280	    | .dlinePolys _ => default
   281	
   282	/-- Read one simultaneous coordinate from a direct diagonal-line answer.  A
   283	zero direction is a singleton geometric line, so it is sent to the
   284	translation-fixed default polynomial; nonzero directions use canonical
   285	rebasing. -/
   286	noncomputable def directDiagonalAnswerReadout (D : DirectLdParams) (r : Fin D.k)
   287	    (line : DiagonalLine D.toLDTParameters) :
   288	    letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
   289	    DirectLdAnswer D → DiagonalLinePolynomial D.toLDTParameters := by
   290	  letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
   291	  intro answer
   292	  by_cases hdir : ldtPointToDirect D line.direction = 0
   293	  · exact default
   294	  · exact match answer with
   295	    | .dlinePolys a => DiagonalLinePolynomial.reparamAt
   296	        (directDiagonalAnswerEquiv D (a r))
   297	        (directScalarEquiv D (directDiagonalRebaseParameter D line))
   298	    | .pointVals _ => default
   299	    | .alinePolys _ => default

   301	/-- Axis answer readout is covariant under mature line rebasing. -/
   302	theorem directAxisAnswerReadout_rebase (D : DirectLdParams) (r : Fin D.k)
   303	    (line : AxisParallelLine D.toLDTParameters)
   304	    (t : Fq D.toLDTParameters) (answer : DirectLdAnswer D) :
   305	    letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
   306	    directAxisAnswerReadout D r (line.rebaseAt t) answer =
   307	      AxisLinePolynomial.reparamAt (directAxisAnswerReadout D r line answer) t := by
   308	  letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
   309	  cases answer with
   310	  | pointVals a => simp [directAxisAnswerReadout]
   311	  | dlinePolys a => simp [directAxisAnswerReadout]
   312	  | alinePolys a =>
   313	      simp only [directAxisAnswerReadout]
   314	      rw [directAxisRebaseParameter_rebase, directScalarEquiv_add]
   315	      rw [(directScalarEquiv D).apply_symm_apply]
   316	      exact (AxisLinePolynomial.reparamAt_reparamAt
   317	        (directAxisAnswerEquiv D (a r)) _ _).symm
   318	
   319	/-- Diagonal answer readout is covariant under mature line rebasing, including
   320	the singleton zero-direction convention. -/
   321	theorem directDiagonalAnswerReadout_rebase (D : DirectLdParams) (r : Fin D.k)
   322	    (line : DiagonalLine D.toLDTParameters)
   323	    (t : Fq D.toLDTParameters) (answer : DirectLdAnswer D) :
   324	    letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
   325	    directDiagonalAnswerReadout D r (line.rebaseAt t) answer =
   326	      DiagonalLinePolynomial.reparamAt
   327	        (directDiagonalAnswerReadout D r line answer) t := by
   328	  letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
   329	  by_cases hdir : ldtPointToDirect D line.direction = 0
   330	  · have hrebase : ldtPointToDirect D (line.rebaseAt t).direction = 0 := by
   331	      simpa [DiagonalLine.rebaseAt] using hdir
   332	    simp [directDiagonalAnswerReadout, hdir, hrebase]
   333	  · have hrebase : ldtPointToDirect D (line.rebaseAt t).direction ≠ 0 := by
   334	      simpa [DiagonalLine.rebaseAt] using hdir
   335	    cases answer with
   336	    | pointVals a =>
   337	        simp [directDiagonalAnswerReadout, hdir, hrebase]
   338	    | alinePolys a =>
   339	        simp [directDiagonalAnswerReadout, hdir, hrebase]
   340	    | dlinePolys a =>
   341	        simp only [directDiagonalAnswerReadout, hdir, hrebase, dite_false]
   342	        rw [directDiagonalRebaseParameter_rebase D line t hdir,
   343	          directScalarEquiv_add, (directScalarEquiv D).apply_symm_apply]
   344	        exact (DiagonalLinePolynomial.reparamAt_reparamAt
   345	          (directDiagonalAnswerEquiv D (a r)) _ _).symm

   349	/-- Regard a matrix-valued projective measurement as a projective measurement
   350	in the mature LDT interface. -/
   351	noncomputable def matrixMeasurementToLDTProjMeas
   352	    {alpha iota : Type*} [Fintype alpha] [Fintype iota] [DecidableEq iota]
   353	    (M : MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement alpha iota)
   354	    (hM : MIPStarRE.QPBT.Measurement.IsProjective M) :
   355	    MIPStarRE.LDT.ProjMeas alpha iota where
   356	  toMeasurement := {
   357	    toSubMeas := {
   358	      outcome := M.effect
   359	      total := 1
   360	      outcome_pos := M.pos
   361	      sum_eq_total := M.sum_eq_one
   362	      total_le_one := le_rfl
   363	    }
   364	    total_eq_one := rfl
   365	  }
   366	  proj a := (hM a).isIdempotentElem.eq
   367	
   368	@[simp] theorem matrixMeasurementToLDTProjMeas_outcome
   369	    {alpha iota : Type*} [Fintype alpha] [Fintype iota] [DecidableEq iota]
   370	    (M : MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement alpha iota)
   371	    (hM : MIPStarRE.QPBT.Measurement.IsProjective M) (a : alpha) :
   372	    (matrixMeasurementToLDTProjMeas M hM).outcome a = M.effect a :=
   373	  rfl

   375	/-- Point measurements obtained by querying the direct strategy and reading
   376	one simultaneous coordinate. -/
   377	noncomputable def directCoordinatePointMeasurement
   378	    (D : DirectLdParams) (r : Fin D.k)
   379	    {iota : Type*} [Fintype iota] [DecidableEq iota]
   380	    (M : DirectLdQuestion D →
   381	      MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement (DirectLdAnswer D) iota)
   382	    (hM : ∀ q, MIPStarRE.QPBT.Measurement.IsProjective (M q)) :
   383	    letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
   384	    IdxProjMeas (Point D.toLDTParameters) (Fq D.toLDTParameters) iota := by
   385	  letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
   386	  intro u
   387	  exact ProjMeas.postprocess
   388	    (matrixMeasurementToLDTProjMeas (M (directPointQuestionOf D u))
   389	      (hM (directPointQuestionOf D u)))
   390	    (directPointAnswerReadout D r)

    29	/-- Relabel a matrix measurement along an equivalence of outcome alphabets. -/
    30	noncomputable def matrixMeasurementTransport
    31	    {alpha beta iota : Type*}
    32	    [Fintype alpha] [Fintype beta] [Fintype iota] [DecidableEq iota]
    33	    (e : alpha ≃ beta) (M : MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement alpha iota) :
    34	    MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement beta iota :=
    35	  MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement.ofSumEqOne
    36	    (fun b => M.effect (e.symm b))
    37	    (fun b => M.pos (e.symm b))
    38	    (by
    39	      calc
    40	        ∑ b, M.effect (e.symm b) = ∑ a, M.effect a :=
    41	          Equiv.sum_comp e.symm M.effect
    42	        _ = 1 := M.sum_eq_one)
    43	
    44	@[simp] theorem matrixMeasurementTransport_effect
    45	    {alpha beta iota : Type*}
    46	    [Fintype alpha] [Fintype beta] [Fintype iota] [DecidableEq iota]
    47	    (e : alpha ≃ beta) (M : MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement alpha iota)
    48	    (b : beta) :
    49	    (matrixMeasurementTransport e M).effect b = M.effect (e.symm b) :=
    50	  rfl
    51	
    52	/-- Relabeling a projective matrix measurement preserves projectivity. -/
    53	theorem matrixMeasurementTransport_isProjective
    54	    {alpha beta iota : Type*}
    55	    [Fintype alpha] [Fintype beta] [Fintype iota] [DecidableEq iota]
    56	    (e : alpha ≃ beta) (M : MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement alpha iota)
    57	    (hM : MIPStarRE.QPBT.Measurement.IsProjective M) :
    58	    MIPStarRE.QPBT.Measurement.IsProjective (matrixMeasurementTransport e M) :=
    59	  fun b => hM (e.symm b)
    60	
    61	/-- Assemble a family of matrix measurements as diagonal blocks indexed by a
    62	finite classical register. -/
    63	noncomputable def blockDiagonalMeasurement
    64	    {alpha iota block : Type*}
    65	    [Fintype alpha] [Fintype iota] [DecidableEq iota]
    66	    [Fintype block] [DecidableEq block]
    67	    (M : block → MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement alpha iota) :
    68	    MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement alpha (iota × block) :=
    69	  MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement.ofSumEqOne
    70	    (fun a => Matrix.blockDiagonal fun r => (M r).effect a)
    71	    (fun a => Matrix.blockDiagonal_nonneg
    72	      (fun r => (M r).effect a) (fun r => (M r).pos a))
    73	    (by
    74	      ext ⟨i, r⟩ ⟨j, s⟩
    75	      simp only [Matrix.sum_apply, Matrix.blockDiagonal_apply]
    76	      by_cases hrs : r = s
    77	      · subst s
    78	        simp only [if_pos]
    79	        calc
    80	          ∑ x, (M r).effect x i j = (1 : Matrix iota iota ℂ) i j :=
    81	            by
    82	              simpa only [Matrix.sum_apply] using
    83	                congrFun (congrFun (M r).sum_eq_one i) j
    84	          _ = (1 : Matrix (iota × block) (iota × block) ℂ)
    85	              (i, r) (j, r) := by
    86	                change (if i = j then 1 else 0) =
    87	                  (if (i, r) = (j, r) then 1 else 0)
    88	                simp
    89	      · simp [hrs])
    90	
    91	@[simp] theorem blockDiagonalMeasurement_effect
    92	    {alpha iota block : Type*}
    93	    [Fintype alpha] [Fintype iota] [DecidableEq iota]
    94	    [Fintype block] [DecidableEq block]
    95	    (M : block → MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement alpha iota)
    96	    (a : alpha) :
    97	    (blockDiagonalMeasurement M).effect a =
    98	      Matrix.blockDiagonal (fun r => (M r).effect a) :=
    99	  rfl
   100	
   101	/-- A block-diagonal family of projective measurements is projective. -/
   102	theorem blockDiagonalMeasurement_isProjective
   103	    {alpha iota block : Type*}
   104	    [Fintype alpha] [Fintype iota] [DecidableEq iota]
   105	    [Fintype block] [DecidableEq block]
   106	    (M : block → MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement alpha iota)
   107	    (hM : ∀ r, MIPStarRE.QPBT.Measurement.IsProjective (M r)) :
   108	    MIPStarRE.QPBT.Measurement.IsProjective (blockDiagonalMeasurement M) := by
   109	  intro a
   110	  constructor
   111	  · change Matrix.blockDiagonal (fun r => (M r).effect a) *
   112	        Matrix.blockDiagonal (fun r => (M r).effect a) =
   113	      Matrix.blockDiagonal (fun r => (M r).effect a)
   114	    rw [← Matrix.blockDiagonal_mul]
   115	    congr 1
   116	    funext r
   117	    exact (hM r a).isIdempotentElem.eq
   118	  · change (Matrix.blockDiagonal (fun r => (M r).effect a))ᴴ =
   119	      Matrix.blockDiagonal (fun r => (M r).effect a)
   120	    rw [Matrix.blockDiagonal_conjTranspose]
   121	    congr 1
   122	    funext r
   123	    exact (hM r a).isSelfAdjoint.star_eq

   125	/-! ## The correlated residue state -/
   126	
   127	/-- The normalized maximally correlated state on the common seed-fiber
   128	residue. -/
   129	noncomputable def seedResidueAncilla (L : LdParams) :
   130	    EuclideanSpace ℂ
   131	      (Fin (L.q / L.m) × Fin (L.q / L.m)) := by
   132	  letI : Nonempty (Fin (L.q / L.m)) :=
   133	    Fin.pos_iff_nonempty.mp L.seedFiberCard_pos
   134	  exact eprState (Fin (L.q / L.m))
   135	
   136	/-- The seed-residue ancilla has unit norm. -/
   137	theorem seedResidueAncilla_norm (L : LdParams) :
   138	    ‖seedResidueAncilla L‖ = 1 := by
   139	  letI : Nonempty (Fin (L.q / L.m)) :=
   140	    Fin.pos_iff_nonempty.mp L.seedFiberCard_pos
   141	  exact eprState_norm (Fin (L.q / L.m))
   142	
   143	/-- Reindexing Euclidean coordinates along an equivalence preserves norm. -/
   144	theorem reindexState_norm_eq
   145	    {iota kappa : Type*}
   146	    [Fintype iota] [DecidableEq iota]
   147	    [Fintype kappa] [DecidableEq kappa]
   148	    (e : iota ≃ kappa) (psi : EuclideanSpace ℂ iota) :
   149	    ‖reindexState e psi‖ = ‖psi‖ := by
   150	  rw [← sq_eq_sq₀ (norm_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _)]
   151	  rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_sq_eq, EuclideanSpace.norm_sq_eq]
   152	  change (∑ j : kappa, ‖psi (e.symm j)‖ ^ 2) = ∑ i : iota, ‖psi i‖ ^ 2
   153	  exact e.symm.sum_comp (fun i => ‖psi i‖ ^ 2)
   154	
   155	/-- The coordinate tensor of two Euclidean vectors has the product norm. -/
   156	theorem vecTensor_norm_eq
   157	    {iota kappa : Type*}
   158	    [Fintype iota] [DecidableEq iota]
   159	    [Fintype kappa] [DecidableEq kappa]
   160	    (u : EuclideanSpace ℂ iota) (v : EuclideanSpace ℂ kappa) :
   161	    ‖vecTensor u v‖ = ‖u‖ * ‖v‖ := by
   162	  rw [← sq_eq_sq₀ (norm_nonneg _) (mul_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _))]
   163	  rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_sq_eq, mul_pow, EuclideanSpace.norm_sq_eq,
   164	    EuclideanSpace.norm_sq_eq]
   165	  change (∑ p : iota × kappa, ‖u p.1 * v p.2‖ ^ 2) =
   166	    (∑ i : iota, ‖u i‖ ^ 2) * ∑ j : kappa, ‖v j‖ ^ 2
   167	  simp only [norm_mul, mul_pow]
   168	  rw [← Finset.univ_product_univ, Finset.sum_product, Finset.sum_mul]
   169	  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
   170	  intro i hi
   171	  rw [Finset.mul_sum]
   172	
   173	/-- Tensor the original strategy state with the maximally correlated residue
   174	state and shuffle the factors back into the two local carriers. -/
   175	noncomputable def seedFiberLiftedState
   176	    {G : Game} (S : Strategy G) (L : LdParams) :
   177	    EuclideanSpace ℂ
   178	      ((S.ιA × Fin (L.q / L.m)) × (S.ιB × Fin (L.q / L.m))) :=
   179	  reindexState prodShuffle (vecTensor S.ψ (seedResidueAncilla L))
   180	
   181	/-- The correlated seed-fiber lift preserves normalization of the strategy
   182	state. -/
   183	theorem seedFiberLiftedState_norm
   184	    {G : Game} (S : Strategy G) (L : LdParams) :
   185	    ‖seedFiberLiftedState S L‖ = 1 := by
   186	  rw [seedFiberLiftedState, reindexState_norm_eq, vecTensor_norm_eq,
   187	    S.ψ_norm, seedResidueAncilla_norm, one_mul]
   188	
   189	/-! ## From the seed-indexed game to the direct game -/
   190	
   191	/-- The seed-indexed question selected in one residue block of a direct
   192	question.  Applying `ldCL` ensures that irrelevant ambient coordinates are
   193	canonicalized exactly as in the source game. -/
   194	noncomputable def seededLdQuestion (L : LdParams)
   195	    (q : DirectLdQuestion L.toDirectLdParams)
   196	    (residue : Fin (L.q / L.m)) : LdQuestion L :=
   197	  (q.1, ldCL L q.1 (ldSpaceOfDirectResidue L q.2 residue))
   198	
   199	/-- Dilate a strategy for the seed-indexed low-degree game to the directly
   200	indexed game.  The two local carriers receive correlated copies of the seed
   201	residue, and each measurement is block diagonal in that residue. -/
   202	noncomputable def ldStrategyToDirect (L : LdParams)
   203	    (S : Strategy (ldGame L)) : Strategy (directLdGame L.toDirectLdParams) where
   204	  ιA := S.ιA × Fin (L.q / L.m)
   205	  ιB := S.ιB × Fin (L.q / L.m)
   206	  ψ := seedFiberLiftedState S L
   207	  ψ_norm := seedFiberLiftedState_norm S L
   208	  A q := blockDiagonalMeasurement fun residue =>
   209	    matrixMeasurementTransport (ldDirectAnswerEquiv L)
   210	      (S.A (seededLdQuestion L q residue))
   211	  B q := blockDiagonalMeasurement fun residue =>
   212	    matrixMeasurementTransport (ldDirectAnswerEquiv L)
   213	      (S.B (seededLdQuestion L q residue))
   214	
   215	/-- Projectivity is preserved by the correlated seed-fiber dilation. -/
   216	theorem ldStrategyToDirect_isProjective (L : LdParams)
   217	    (S : Strategy (ldGame L)) (hS : S.IsProjective) :
   218	    (ldStrategyToDirect L S).IsProjective := by
   219	  constructor
   220	  · intro q
   221	    apply blockDiagonalMeasurement_isProjective
   222	    intro residue
   223	    apply matrixMeasurementTransport_isProjective
   224	    exact hS.1 (seededLdQuestion L q residue)
   225	  · intro q
   226	    apply blockDiagonalMeasurement_isProjective
   227	    intro residue
   228	    apply matrixMeasurementTransport_isProjective
   229	    exact hS.2 (seededLdQuestion L q residue)
   230	
   231	@[simp] theorem ldStrategyToDirect_A_effect (L : LdParams)
   232	    (S : Strategy (ldGame L))
   233	    (q : DirectLdQuestion L.toDirectLdParams)
   234	    (answer : DirectLdAnswer L.toDirectLdParams) :
   235	    ((ldStrategyToDirect L S).A q).effect answer =
   236	      Matrix.blockDiagonal fun residue =>
   237	        (S.A (seededLdQuestion L q residue)).effect
   238	          ((ldDirectAnswerEquiv L).symm answer) :=
   239	  rfl
   240	
   241	@[simp] theorem ldStrategyToDirect_B_effect (L : LdParams)
   242	    (S : Strategy (ldGame L))
   243	    (q : DirectLdQuestion L.toDirectLdParams)
   244	    (answer : DirectLdAnswer L.toDirectLdParams) :
   245	    ((ldStrategyToDirect L S).B q).effect answer =
   246	      Matrix.blockDiagonal fun residue =>
   247	        (S.B (seededLdQuestion L q residue)).effect
   248	          ((ldDirectAnswerEquiv L).symm answer) :=
   249	  rfl
   250	
   251	/-- A direct question reconstructed in a residue block parses back to its
   252	canonical direct form. -/
   253	theorem parse_seededLdQuestion (L : LdParams)
   254	    (q : DirectLdQuestion L.toDirectLdParams)
   255	    (residue : Fin (L.q / L.m)) :
   256	    parseLdQuestion L (seededLdQuestion L q residue) =
   257	      (q.1, directLdMap L.toDirectLdParams q.1 q.2) := by
   258	  exact parseLdQuestion_ldCL_ofDirectResidue L q.1 q.2 residue
   259	
   260	/-- Coordinate formula for the correlated residue lift. -/
   261	theorem seedFiberLiftedState_apply
   262	    {G : Game} (S : Strategy G) (L : LdParams)
   263	    (i : S.ιA) (j : S.ιB)
   264	    (r s : Fin (L.q / L.m)) :
   265	    seedFiberLiftedState S L ((i, r), (j, s)) =
   266	      if r = s then
   267	        S.ψ (i, j) * (Real.sqrt (Fintype.card (Fin (L.q / L.m)) : ℝ) : ℂ)⁻¹
   268	      else 0 := by
   269	  letI : Nonempty (Fin (L.q / L.m)) :=
   270	    Fin.pos_iff_nonempty.mp L.seedFiberCard_pos
   271	  simp [seedFiberLiftedState, reindexState, vecTensor, seedResidueAncilla,
   272	    eprState, prodShuffle]
   273	
   274	end

    72	/-- Turn a coefficient vector into its polynomial of degree at most `n`. -/
    73	private noncomputable def coefficientPolynomial
    74	    {K : Type*} [Field K] (n : ℕ) (c : Fin (n + 1) → K) : Polynomial K :=
    75	  ((Polynomial.degreeLTEquiv K (n + 1)).symm c).1
    76	
    77	private theorem coefficientPolynomial_degree_le
    78	    {K : Type*} [Field K] (n : ℕ) (c : Fin (n + 1) → K) :
    79	    (coefficientPolynomial n c).natDegree ≤ n := by
    80	  let p := (Polynomial.degreeLTEquiv K (n + 1)).symm c
    81	  have hp : p.1 ∈ Polynomial.degreeLE K n := by
    82	    rw [← Polynomial.degreeLT_succ_eq_degreeLE]
    83	    exact p.2
    84	  have hdegree : p.1.degree ≤ n := Polynomial.mem_degreeLE.mp hp
    85	  by_cases hzero : p.1 = 0
    86	  · simp [coefficientPolynomial, p, hzero]
    87	  · exact Polynomial.natDegree_le_iff_degree_le.mpr hdegree
    88	
    89	@[simp] private theorem coefficientPolynomial_coeff
    90	    {K : Type*} [Field K] (n : ℕ) (c : Fin (n + 1) → K)
    91	    (i : Fin (n + 1)) :
    92	    (coefficientPolynomial n c).coeff i = c i := by
    93	  exact congrFun ((Polynomial.degreeLTEquiv K (n + 1)).apply_symm_apply c) i
    94	
    95	private theorem coefficientPolynomial_eval
    96	    {K : Type*} [Field K] (n : ℕ) (c : Fin (n + 1) → K) (t : K) :
    97	    (coefficientPolynomial n c).eval t = evalCoefficient c t := by
    98	  simpa [coefficientPolynomial, evalCoefficient] using
    99	    (Polynomial.eval_eq_sum_degreeLTEquiv
   100	      (((Polynomial.degreeLTEquiv K (n + 1)).symm c).2) t)

   102	/-- Direct axis-line coefficients are equivalent to mature bounded axis-line
   103	polynomials over the fixed field model. -/
   104	noncomputable def directAxisAnswerEquiv (D : DirectLdParams) :
   105	    letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
   106	    DirectDegPoly D D.d ≃ AxisLinePolynomial D.toLDTParameters := by
   107	  letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
   108	  refine
   109	    { toFun := fun c =>
   110	        { poly := coefficientPolynomial D.d c
   111	          degreeBounded := coefficientPolynomial_degree_le D.d c }
   112	      invFun := fun f i => f.poly.coeff i
   113	      left_inv := ?_
   114	      right_inv := ?_ }
   115	  · intro c
   116	    funext i
   117	    exact coefficientPolynomial_coeff D.d c i
   118	  · intro f
   119	    apply AxisLinePolynomial.ext
   120	    apply linePolynomial_coeff_fin_injective D.toLDTParameters
   121	      (coefficientPolynomial_degree_le D.d fun i => f.poly.coeff i)
   122	      f.degreeBounded
   123	    intro i
   124	    exact coefficientPolynomial_coeff D.d (fun j => f.poly.coeff j) i
   125	
   126	/-- Direct diagonal-line coefficients are equivalent to mature bounded
   127	diagonal-line polynomials over the fixed field model. -/

   129	    letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
   130	    DirectDegPoly D (D.m * D.d) ≃ DiagonalLinePolynomial D.toLDTParameters := by
   131	  letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
   132	  refine
   133	    { toFun := fun c =>
   134	        { poly := coefficientPolynomial (D.m * D.d) c
   135	          degreeBounded := coefficientPolynomial_degree_le (D.m * D.d) c }
   136	      invFun := fun f i => f.poly.coeff i
   137	      left_inv := ?_
   138	      right_inv := ?_ }
   139	  · intro c
   140	    funext i
   141	    exact coefficientPolynomial_coeff (D.m * D.d) c i
   142	  · intro f
   143	    apply DiagonalLinePolynomial.ext
   144	    apply linePolynomial_coeff_fin_injective D.toLDTParameters
   145	      (coefficientPolynomial_degree_le (D.m * D.d) fun i => f.poly.coeff i)
   146	      f.degreeBounded
   147	    intro i
   148	    exact coefficientPolynomial_coeff (D.m * D.d) (fun j => f.poly.coeff j) i

   151	axis-line polynomial. -/

   215	/-- Casting between equal finite cardinalities preserves the underlying
   216	natural-number representative. -/
   217	@[simp] private theorem equivCastFin_val {m n : ℕ} (h : m = n) (i : Fin m) :
   218	    (Equiv.cast (congrArg Fin h) i).val = i.val := by

   225	    ScalarQ L ≃ Fin L.m × Fin (L.q / L.m) :=

   227	    (Equiv.cast <| congrArg Fin L.seedFiberProduct_eq).trans

   145	theorem directDiagonalIndexOf_eq (D : DirectLdParams)
   146	    {v : Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D} {i : Fin D.m}
   147	    (hzero : ∀ j : Fin D.m, j.val < i.val → v j = 0) (hi : v i ≠ 0) :
   148	    directDiagonalIndexOf D v = i := by
   149	  classical
   150	  have hmem : i ∈ directionSupport D v := (mem_directionSupport D v i).mpr hi
   151	  have hnonempty : (directionSupport D v).Nonempty := ⟨i, hmem⟩
   152	  unfold directDiagonalIndexOf
   153	  rw [dif_pos hnonempty]
   154	  apply le_antisymm
   155	  · exact Finset.min'_le _ _ hmem
   156	  · apply Finset.le_min'
   157	    intro j hj
   158	    by_contra hlt
   159	    exact (mem_directionSupport D v j).mp hj
   160	      (hzero j (Fin.lt_def.mp (not_le.mp hlt)))
   161	
   162	/-- The leading index of a prefix-projected direction is the projection index
   163	whenever the direction is nonzero there.  This is the generic direct
   164	diagonal sample: the sampled index is recovered from the projected direction
   165	alone. -/
   166	theorem directDiagonalIndexOf_prefixProjection (D : DirectLdParams)
   167	    (i : Fin D.m) (v : Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D) (hi : v i ≠ 0) :
   168	    directDiagonalIndexOf D (directPrefixProjection i v) = i := by
   169	  apply directDiagonalIndexOf_eq
   170	  · intro j hj
   171	    simp [directPrefixProjection, hj]
   172	  · simpa [directPrefixProjection] using hi
   173	
   174	/-- Prefix projection at the leading index is the identity. -/
   175	theorem directPrefixProjection_directDiagonalIndexOf (D : DirectLdParams)
   176	    (v : Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D) :
   177	    directPrefixProjection (directDiagonalIndexOf D v) v = v := by
   178	  funext j
   179	  unfold directPrefixProjection
   180	  split_ifs with hj
   181	  · exact (directDiagonalIndexOf_prefix_zero D v j hj).symm
   182	  · rfl
   183	
   184	/-! ## Decoding mature points and lines -/
   185	
   186	/-- Decode a mature LDT point into the fixed direct scalar field, reversing
   187	the coordinate order. -/
   188	abbrev ldtPointToDirect (D : DirectLdParams) :
   189	    Point D.toLDTParameters → Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D :=
   190	  (directPointEquiv D).symm
   191	
   192	/-- The direct canonical axis question represented by a mature axis line.
   193	The mature coordinate index is reversed together with the point
   194	coordinates. -/
   195	noncomputable def directAxisQuestionOf (D : DirectLdParams)
   196	    (line : AxisParallelLine D.toLDTParameters) : DirectLdQuestion D :=
   197	  let u := ldtPointToDirect D line.base
   198	  let i : Fin D.m := Fin.rev line.direction
   199	  let v : Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D := coordinateDirection i
   200	  (.aline, ⟨lineRepMap v u, i, 0⟩)
   201	
   202	/-- The direct canonical diagonal question represented by a mature diagonal
   203	line.  The decoded direction is kept and the direct index is its leading
   204	index, so the question is the canonical direct question of the direct sample
   205	formed by the decoded base, the leading index, and the decoded direction
   206	(`directDiagonalQuestionOf_eq_directLdMap`). -/
   207	noncomputable def directDiagonalQuestionOf (D : DirectLdParams)
   208	    (line : DiagonalLine D.toLDTParameters) : DirectLdQuestion D :=
   209	  let u := ldtPointToDirect D line.base
   210	  let v := ldtPointToDirect D line.direction
   211	  (.dline, ⟨lineRepMap v u, directDiagonalIndexOf D v, v⟩)
   212	
   213	/-- The direct point question represented by a mature LDT point. -/
   214	noncomputable def directPointQuestionOf (D : DirectLdParams)
   215	    (u : Point D.toLDTParameters) : DirectLdQuestion D :=
   216	  directLdPointQuestionOf D (ldtPointToDirect D u)
   217	
   218	/-- Every transported diagonal question is the canonical direct question of
   219	the direct sample carrying the leading index, hence lies in the support of
   220	the direct diagonal sampler. -/
   221	theorem directDiagonalQuestionOf_eq_directLdMap (D : DirectLdParams)
   222	    (line : DiagonalLine D.toLDTParameters) :
   223	    directDiagonalQuestionOf D line =
   224	      (.dline, directLdMap D .dline
   225	        ⟨ldtPointToDirect D line.base,
   226	          directDiagonalIndexOf D (ldtPointToDirect D line.direction),
   227	          ldtPointToDirect D line.direction⟩) := by
   228	  unfold directDiagonalQuestionOf directLdMap
   229	  simp only [directPrefixProjection_directDiagonalIndexOf]
   230	
   231	/-- The mature diagonal line represented by a direct sample: the encoded
   232	point and the encoded direction. -/
   233	def matureDiagonalLineOf (D : DirectLdParams) (sample : DirectLdSpace D) :
   234	    DiagonalLine D.toLDTParameters :=
   235	  { base := directPointEquiv D sample.point
   236	    direction := directPointEquiv D sample.direction }
   237	
   238	/-- Round trip on generic direct samples: when the sampled direction is
   239	nonzero at the sampled index, the mature line of the canonical direct
   240	diagonal question transports back to that question, index included. -/

241	theorem directDiagonalQuestionOf_matureDiagonalLineOf (D : DirectLdParams)
   242	    (sample : DirectLdSpace D)
   243	    (hgeneric : sample.direction sample.index ≠ 0) :
   244	    directDiagonalQuestionOf D
   245	        (matureDiagonalLineOf D (directLdMap D .dline sample)) =
   246	      (.dline, directLdMap D .dline sample) := by
   247	  cases sample with
   248	  | mk point index direction =>
   249	      unfold directDiagonalQuestionOf matureDiagonalLineOf directLdMap
   250	      simp only [ldtPointToDirect, Equiv.symm_apply_apply, lineRepMap_apply_self,
   251	        directDiagonalIndexOf_prefixProjection D index direction hgeneric]
   252	
   253	/-- A mature `j`-restricted diagonal direction decodes to a direct direction
   254	vanishing before index `Fin.rev j`: the suffix restriction of the mature
   255	test is the prefix restriction of the direct game. -/
   256	theorem ldtPointToDirect_extendRestrictedDirection_prefix_zero
   257	    (D : DirectLdParams) (j : Fin D.m)
   258	    (free : Fin (j.val + 1) → Fq D.toLDTParameters) :
   259	    letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
   260	    ∀ c : Fin D.m, c.val < (Fin.rev j).val →
   261	      ldtPointToDirect D (extendRestrictedDirection j free) c = 0 := by
   262	  letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
   263	  intro c hc
   264	  have hj := j.isLt
   265	  have hgt : ¬ (Fin.rev c).val ≤ j.val := by
   266	    rw [Fin.val_rev] at hc ⊢
   267	    omega
   268	  simp only [ldtPointToDirect, directPointEquiv_symm_apply,
   269	    extendRestrictedDirection, dif_neg hgt]
   270	  exact (FieldModel.equiv (q := D.q)).symm_apply_apply 0
   271	
   272	/-- The leading index of a decoded `j`-restricted direction is `Fin.rev j`
   273	exactly on the generic event that its pivot coordinate `j` is nonzero. -/
   274	theorem directDiagonalIndexOf_extendRestrictedDirection
   275	    (D : DirectLdParams) (j : Fin D.m)
   276	    (free : Fin (j.val + 1) → Fq D.toLDTParameters) :
   277	    letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
   278	    free ⟨j.val, Nat.lt_succ_self _⟩ ≠ zeroCoord →
   279	      directDiagonalIndexOf D
   280	          (ldtPointToDirect D (extendRestrictedDirection j free)) =
   281	        Fin.rev j := by
   282	  letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
   283	  intro hpivot
   284	  apply directDiagonalIndexOf_eq
   285	  · exact ldtPointToDirect_extendRestrictedDirection_prefix_zero D j free
   286	  · simp only [ldtPointToDirect, directPointEquiv_symm_apply, Fin.rev_rev,
   287	      extendRestrictedDirection, dif_pos (le_refl j.val)]
   288	    intro h
   289	    apply hpivot
   290	    have hcoded := congrArg (directScalarEquiv D) h
   291	    rw [Equiv.apply_symm_apply] at hcoded
   292	    exact hcoded
   293	
   294	/-! ## Rebasing lines -/
   295	
   296	/-- Decoding an axis-line rebase is translation by the decoded scalar along
   297	the reversed direct coordinate direction. -/
   298	theorem ldtPointToDirect_axis_rebase (D : DirectLdParams)
   299	    (line : AxisParallelLine D.toLDTParameters)
   300	    (t : Fq D.toLDTParameters) :
   301	    letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
   302	    ldtPointToDirect D (line.rebaseAt t).base =
   303	      ldtPointToDirect D line.base +
   304	        (directScalarEquiv D).symm t •
   305	          coordinateDirection (Fin.rev line.direction) := by
   306	  letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
   307	  funext i
   308	  simp only [ldtPointToDirect, directPointEquiv_symm_apply,
   309	    AxisParallelLine.rebaseAt, AxisParallelLine.pointAt, Pi.add_apply,
   310	    Pi.smul_apply]
   311	  by_cases hi : i = Fin.rev line.direction
   312	  · subst hi
   313	    simp only [coordinateDirection, Fin.rev_rev, if_pos, smul_eq_mul]
   314	    rw [Pi.single_eq_same, mul_one]
   315	    exact (FieldModel.equiv (q := D.q)).symm_apply_apply _
   316	  · have hrev : Fin.rev i ≠ line.direction := by
   317	      intro h
   318	      apply hi
   319	      rw [← h, Fin.rev_rev]
   320	    simp [hi, hrev, coordinateDirection]
   321	
   322	/-- Decoding a diagonal-line rebase is translation by the decoded scalar
   323	along the decoded direct direction. -/
   324	theorem ldtPointToDirect_diagonal_rebase (D : DirectLdParams)
   325	    (line : DiagonalLine D.toLDTParameters)
   326	    (t : Fq D.toLDTParameters) :
   327	    letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
   328	    ldtPointToDirect D (line.rebaseAt t).base =
   329	      ldtPointToDirect D line.base +
   330	        (directScalarEquiv D).symm t • ldtPointToDirect D line.direction := by
   331	  letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
   332	  funext i
   333	  change decodeScalar
   334	      (addCoord (line.base (Fin.rev i))
   335	        (mulCoord t (line.direction (Fin.rev i)))) =
   336	    decodeScalar (line.base (Fin.rev i)) +
   337	      decodeScalar t * decodeScalar (line.direction (Fin.rev i))
   338	  simp [addCoord, mulCoord]
   339	
   340	/-- Canonical direct axis questions do not depend on the chosen base point of
   341	the mature line. -/
   342	theorem directAxisQuestionOf_rebase (D : DirectLdParams)
   343	    (line : AxisParallelLine D.toLDTParameters)
   344	    (t : Fq D.toLDTParameters) :
   345	    letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
   346	    directAxisQuestionOf D (line.rebaseAt t) = directAxisQuestionOf D line := by
   347	  letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
   348	  simp only [directAxisQuestionOf, AxisParallelLine.rebaseAt_direction]
   349	  rw [ldtPointToDirect_axis_rebase, lineRepMap_add_smul]
   350	
   351	/-- Canonical direct diagonal questions do not depend on the chosen base point
   352	of the mature line; the leading index depends only on the direction. -/
   353	theorem directDiagonalQuestionOf_rebase (D : DirectLdParams)
   354	    (line : DiagonalLine D.toLDTParameters)
   355	    (t : Fq D.toLDTParameters) :
   356	    letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
   357	    directDiagonalQuestionOf D (line.rebaseAt t) =
   358	      directDiagonalQuestionOf D line := by
   359	  letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
   360	  simp only [directDiagonalQuestionOf, DiagonalLine.rebaseAt]
   361	  have hrebase := ldtPointToDirect_diagonal_rebase D line t
   362	  change ldtPointToDirect D (line.pointAt t) =
   363	      ldtPointToDirect D line.base +
   364	        (directScalarEquiv D).symm t • ldtPointToDirect D line.direction at hrebase
   365	  rw [hrebase, lineRepMap_add_smul]
   366	
   367	/-- The fixed scalar coding transports field addition to mature coordinate
   368	addition. -/
   369	theorem directScalarEquiv_add (D : DirectLdParams)
   370	    (x y : DirectScalarQ D) :
   371	    letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
   372	    directScalarEquiv D (x + y) =
   373	      addCoord (directScalarEquiv D x) (directScalarEquiv D y) := by
   374	  letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
   375	  change FieldModel.equiv (x + y) =
   376	    FieldModel.equiv
   377	      (FieldModel.equiv.symm (FieldModel.equiv x) +
   378	        FieldModel.equiv.symm (FieldModel.equiv y))
   379	  rw [FieldModel.equiv.symm_apply_apply, FieldModel.equiv.symm_apply_apply]
   380	
   381	private theorem coordinateDirection_ne_zero
   382	    {K : Type*} [Field K] {m : ℕ} (i : Fin m) :
   383	    (coordinateDirection i : Fin m → K) ≠ 0 := by
   384	  intro h
   385	  have hi := congrFun h i
   386	  simp [coordinateDirection] at hi
   387	
   388	/-- Canonical rebase parameter for a mature axis-parallel line. -/
   389	noncomputable def directAxisRebaseParameter (D : DirectLdParams)
   390	    (line : AxisParallelLine D.toLDTParameters) : DirectScalarQ D :=
   391	  directLineRepParameter (coordinateDirection (Fin.rev line.direction))
   392	    (ldtPointToDirect D line.base)
   393	
   394	/-- Canonical rebase parameter for a mature diagonal line. -/
   395	noncomputable def directDiagonalRebaseParameter (D : DirectLdParams)
   396	    (line : DiagonalLine D.toLDTParameters) : DirectScalarQ D :=
   397	  directLineRepParameter (ldtPointToDirect D line.direction)
   398	    (ldtPointToDirect D line.base)
   399	
   400	/-- Axis-line canonical parameters add under mature rebasing. -/
   401	theorem directAxisRebaseParameter_rebase (D : DirectLdParams)
   402	    (line : AxisParallelLine D.toLDTParameters)
   403	    (t : Fq D.toLDTParameters) :
   404	    letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
   405	    directAxisRebaseParameter D (line.rebaseAt t) =
   406	      directAxisRebaseParameter D line + (directScalarEquiv D).symm t := by
   407	  letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
   408	  unfold directAxisRebaseParameter
   409	  rw [ldtPointToDirect_axis_rebase]
   410	  exact directLineRepParameter_add_smul
   411	    (coordinateDirection_ne_zero (Fin.rev line.direction)) _
   412	
   413	/-- Nonzero diagonal-line canonical parameters add under mature rebasing. -/
   414	theorem directDiagonalRebaseParameter_rebase (D : DirectLdParams)
   415	    (line : DiagonalLine D.toLDTParameters)
   416	    (t : Fq D.toLDTParameters)
   417	    (hdir : ldtPointToDirect D line.direction ≠ 0) :
   418	    letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
   419	    directDiagonalRebaseParameter D (line.rebaseAt t) =
   420	      directDiagonalRebaseParameter D line + (directScalarEquiv D).symm t := by
   421	  letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
   422	  unfold directDiagonalRebaseParameter
   423	  rw [ldtPointToDirect_diagonal_rebase]
   424	  exact directLineRepParameter_add_smul hdir _
   425	
   426	/-! ## Reading direct answers as mature answers -/
   427	
   428	/-- The constant diagonal-line answer with the given direct value. -/
   429	noncomputable def constantDiagonalAnswer (D : DirectLdParams)
   430	    (x : DirectScalarQ D) :
   431	    letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
   432	    DiagonalLinePolynomial D.toLDTParameters := by
   433	  letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
   434	  exact { poly := Polynomial.C x
   435	          degreeBounded := by simp }
   436	
   437	/-- Constant answers are fixed by every reparametrization. -/
   438	theorem constantDiagonalAnswer_reparamAt (D : DirectLdParams)
   439	    (x : DirectScalarQ D) (t : Fq D.toLDTParameters) :
   440	    letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
   441	    DiagonalLinePolynomial.reparamAt (constantDiagonalAnswer D x) t =
   442	      constantDiagonalAnswer D x := by
   443	  letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
   444	  apply DiagonalLinePolynomial.ext
   445	  simp [constantDiagonalAnswer, DiagonalLinePolynomial.reparamAt]
   446	
   447	/-- A constant answer evaluates to its value at every parameter. -/
   448	theorem constantDiagonalAnswer_apply (D : DirectLdParams)
   449	    (x : DirectScalarQ D) (t : Fq D.toLDTParameters) :
   450	    letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
   451	    constantDiagonalAnswer D x t = directScalarEquiv D x := by
   452	  letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
   453	  change encodeScalar ((Polynomial.C x).eval (decodeScalar t)) =
   454	    directScalarEquiv D x
   455	  rw [Polynomial.eval_C]
   456	  rfl
   457	
   458	/-- Read one simultaneous coordinate from a direct point answer. -/
   459	noncomputable def directPointAnswerReadout (D : DirectLdParams) (r : Fin D.k) :
   460	    letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
   461	    DirectLdAnswer D → Fq D.toLDTParameters := by
   462	  letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
   463	  intro answer
   464	  exact match answer with
   465	    | .pointVals a => directScalarEquiv D (a r)
   466	    | .alinePolys _ => directScalarEquiv D 0
   467	    | .dlinePolys _ => directScalarEquiv D 0
   468	
   469	/-- Read one simultaneous coordinate from a direct axis-line answer and
   470	rebase its polynomial from the canonical direct line to the mature line. -/
   471	noncomputable def directAxisAnswerReadout (D : DirectLdParams) (r : Fin D.k)
   472	    (line : AxisParallelLine D.toLDTParameters) :
   473	    letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
   474	    DirectLdAnswer D → AxisLinePolynomial D.toLDTParameters := by
   475	  letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
   476	  intro answer
   477	  exact match answer with
   478	    | .alinePolys a => AxisLinePolynomial.reparamAt
   479	        (directAxisAnswerEquiv D (a r))
   480	        (directScalarEquiv D (directAxisRebaseParameter D line))
   481	    | .pointVals _ => default
   482	    | .dlinePolys _ => default
   483	
   484	/-- Read one simultaneous coordinate from a direct diagonal-line answer.  For
   485	a nonzero direction the polynomial is rebased from the canonical direct line
   486	to the mature line.  A zero direction is the singleton line through its base,
   487	where the direct predicate accepts an answer exactly when its polynomial
   488	function is constant with the point's value (`rem:ld-win-zero-direction`);
   489	the answer is read as the constant polynomial carrying its value at the base
   490	point, which is fixed by every reparametrization.  Wrong-form answers are
   491	sent to the default polynomial. -/
   492	noncomputable def directDiagonalAnswerReadout (D : DirectLdParams) (r : Fin D.k)
   493	    (line : DiagonalLine D.toLDTParameters) :
   494	    letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
   495	    DirectLdAnswer D → DiagonalLinePolynomial D.toLDTParameters := by
   496	  letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
   497	  classical
   498	  intro answer
   499	  exact match answer with
   500	    | .dlinePolys a =>
   501	        if ldtPointToDirect D line.direction = 0 then
   502	          constantDiagonalAnswer D (evalCoefficient (a r) 0)
   503	        else
   504	          DiagonalLinePolynomial.reparamAt (directDiagonalAnswerEquiv D (a r))
   505	            (directScalarEquiv D (directDiagonalRebaseParameter D line))
   506	    | .pointVals _ => default
   507	    | .alinePolys _ => default
   508	
   509	/-- Axis answer readout is covariant under mature line rebasing. -/
   510	theorem directAxisAnswerReadout_rebase (D : DirectLdParams) (r : Fin D.k)
   511	    (line : AxisParallelLine D.toLDTParameters)
   512	    (t : Fq D.toLDTParameters) (answer : DirectLdAnswer D) :
   513	    letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
   514	    directAxisAnswerReadout D r (line.rebaseAt t) answer =
   515	      AxisLinePolynomial.reparamAt (directAxisAnswerReadout D r line answer) t := by
   516	  letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
   517	  cases answer with
   518	  | pointVals a => simp [directAxisAnswerReadout]
   519	  | dlinePolys a => simp [directAxisAnswerReadout]
   520	  | alinePolys a =>
   521	      simp only [directAxisAnswerReadout]
   522	      rw [directAxisRebaseParameter_rebase, directScalarEquiv_add]
   523	      rw [(directScalarEquiv D).apply_symm_apply]
   524	      exact (AxisLinePolynomial.reparamAt_reparamAt
   525	        (directAxisAnswerEquiv D (a r)) _ _).symm
   526	
   527	/-- Diagonal answer readout is covariant under mature line rebasing, including
   528	the constant zero-direction convention. -/
   529	theorem directDiagonalAnswerReadout_rebase (D : DirectLdParams) (r : Fin D.k)
   530	    (line : DiagonalLine D.toLDTParameters)
   531	    (t : Fq D.toLDTParameters) (answer : DirectLdAnswer D) :
   532	    letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
   533	    directDiagonalAnswerReadout D r (line.rebaseAt t) answer =
   534	      DiagonalLinePolynomial.reparamAt
   535	        (directDiagonalAnswerReadout D r line answer) t := by
   536	  letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
   537	  cases answer with
   538	  | pointVals a => simp [directDiagonalAnswerReadout]
   539	  | alinePolys a => simp [directDiagonalAnswerReadout]
   540	  | dlinePolys a =>
   541	      by_cases hdir : ldtPointToDirect D line.direction = 0
   542	      · have hrebase : ldtPointToDirect D (line.rebaseAt t).direction = 0 := by
   543	          simpa [DiagonalLine.rebaseAt] using hdir
   544	        simp [directDiagonalAnswerReadout, hdir, hrebase,
   545	          constantDiagonalAnswer_reparamAt]
   546	      · have hrebase : ldtPointToDirect D (line.rebaseAt t).direction ≠ 0 := by
   547	          simpa [DiagonalLine.rebaseAt] using hdir
   548	        simp only [directDiagonalAnswerReadout, hdir, hrebase, ↓reduceIte]
   549	        rw [directDiagonalRebaseParameter_rebase D line t hdir,
   550	          directScalarEquiv_add, (directScalarEquiv D).apply_symm_apply]
   551	        exact (DiagonalLinePolynomial.reparamAt_reparamAt
   552	          (directDiagonalAnswerEquiv D (a r)) _ _).symm
   553	
   554	end
   555	
   556	end MIPStarRE.QPBT

     5	/-!
     6	# Geometry for the directly indexed low-degree game
     7	
     8	This module defines the parameters, line carrier, and line-point distributions
     9	for the directly indexed low-degree game.
    10	
    11	## References
    12	
    13	The line-point distributions originate in
    14	`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:243-272`.
    15	The directly indexed repair is documented in
    16	`docs/paper-gaps/qpbt_ld-dimension-divisibility.tex`.
    17	-/

    20
